value.content:
A Claude Code mod is text and configuration inside your project that changes what the agent does. In this video: skill, agent and configuration, with examples from this repository (13 skills, 5 agents and one rule that asks for confirmation before scheduling a post).

The presenter is a drawing made from my photos; the voice is mine, cloned by AI.

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #Programming #Dev
